title: The Umbrella Man
mood: warm desert sun, dry dusty air, playful and mischievous

voice.delivery: calm deadpan storyteller, dry wit, unhurried pace

music: quirky understated instrumental, pizzicato strings, soft marimba, light shuffle percussion, mischievous small-town mood, loopable

characters.walt: middle-aged umbrella seller; wide straw sun hat with a red band, short black hair under it, tiny grey moustache, half-lidded deadpan eyes; mustard-yellow vest over a white shirt as the bean-shaped torso; always holding a closed black umbrella
characters.sheriff: town sheriff; tan cowboy hat with a gold star badge on it, aviator sunglasses, thick brown moustache; dark green uniform torso with a gold star on the chest
characters.townsfolk: assorted townspeople in the same character style: one in a pink sun bonnet, one in a blue baseball cap, one bald with round glasses, plain pastel shirt torsos

locations.main_street: a sun-baked small desert town main street: adobe and clapboard storefronts, a saloon, a general store, cracked asphalt, tumbleweeds, a tall rusty water tower on stilts looming over the street, cacti, heat shimmer
locations.stall: Walt's tiny wooden umbrella stall on the sidewalk of the desert main street: striped awning, rows of colourful folded umbrellas in a barrel, a hand-painted price board with no readable text
locations.tower_night: the top of the rusty town water tower at night: catwalk railing, big iron valve wheel, moonlight, town lights twinkling far below
locations.sky: huge desert sky over the town

shots.visual: Walt stands proudly beside his umbrella stall under a blazing sun, everything around him dry and dusty
shots.motion: Walt gives one slow confident nod; heat shimmer ripples; a tumbleweed rolls past
shots.narration: This man sells umbrellas in the driest town in America.

shots.visual: a bone-dry glass rain gauge on a fence post, filled with dust and one dead fly, cracked earth below
shots.motion: dust blows off the rim of the gauge; a lizard scurries past
shots.narration: It hasn't rained here in forty-one years.

shots.visual: three townsfolk walk past the stall pointing and laughing, Walt small in the background
shots.motion: townsfolk bounce as they walk, one doubles over laughing
shots.narration: Every morning, people walk past his stall and laugh.

shots.visual: close-up of Walt's completely unbothered half-lidded deadpan face
shots.motion: Walt blinks slowly, once; his moustache twitches

shots.visual: a worn leather sales ledger on the stall counter, open to a page with a single big hand-drawn zero circled
shots.motion: the page corner flutters in the hot wind

shots.visual: dusk; Walt stands at the foot of the giant rusty water tower, staring up at it, tiny next to it
shots.motion: camera cranes down from the top of the tower to Walt; his eyebrows slowly rise
shots.narration: Then one evening, he looks up at the town water tower.

shots.visual: first-person POV climbing the ladder at night, Walt's cartoon hands gripping the rungs, a wrench in his back pocket visible, the tower top above
shots.motion: hands climb rung over rung, slight sway, stars above

shots.visual: Walt on the catwalk with both hands on the huge iron valve wheel, a sly grin
shots.motion: Walt heaves and the wheel starts turning; a squeal of rust; moonlight glints
shots.narration: At exactly eight a.m., right as the morning crowd walks by...

shots.visual: morning; a sheet of water pours from the water tower over Main Street only; townsfolk drenched mid-step, shocked faces, the rest of town bone dry
shots.motion: water cascades and splashes, townsfolk jump with wide eyes, puddles spread
shots.narration: ...it rains. On Main Street. Only on Main Street.

shots.visual: Walt pops open a bright red umbrella at his stall, perfectly dry, big satisfied grin, rain falling around him
shots.motion: the umbrella snaps open with a bounce; Walt raises one finger like a salesman

shots.visual: a long queue of soaked townsfolk lines up at the stall, Walt handing out umbrellas and taking cash
shots.motion: the queue shuffles forward, umbrellas pop open one after another down the line
shots.narration: He sells out in nine minutes.

shots.visual: Main Street from above, a colourful river of open umbrellas moving down the street under the tower's waterfall
shots.motion: camera flies forward over the umbrellas; they bob as people walk
shots.narration: He does it again on Tuesday. And Wednesday. And Thursday.

shots.visual: the sheriff stands under the water tower, sunglasses tilted down, tapping the hollow tank with a knuckle, a clipboard in his other hand
shots.motion: knock knock - the tank booms hollow; the sheriff lowers his sunglasses slowly
shots.narration: By Friday, the sheriff notices the water tower is completely empty.

shots.visual: Walt behind the empty stall, a single sweat drop on his forehead, eyes darting sideways
shots.motion: the sweat drop slides down; Walt's eyes dart left then right
shots.narration: Walt is in a lot of trouble.

shots.visual: for the first time, enormous dark storm clouds roll over the desert town, a flash of lightning
shots.motion: clouds billow and roll in fast, lightning flickers, the first real raindrops fall
shots.narration: And then, for the first time in forty-one years, it actually rains.

shots.visual: Walt stands soaking wet beside his completely empty umbrella barrel in a real downpour, hat drooping, deadpan
shots.motion: rain hammers down, Walt's hat brim droops and pours water, he blinks once
shots.narration: Walt sold every umbrella he had.

shots.visual: close-up of Walt, drenched, holding the bare metal skeleton of an umbrella with no canopy over his head
shots.motion: water drips through the empty frame onto his face; he sighs
